name: Summer With You
source:
For Kai, every day at school is a repetition of the previous one. Bullies beat him, taunt his childhood friend Yuka, his sister accuses him of not being manly - it happens over and over again. His only joy in life is hanging out at home with Yuka and her mother, Rin, who runs a village pharmacy. Only here he can truly have fun and hide from the harsh world and all the hardships that come his way. But when he looks at Yuka's cheerful face, the realization of his weakness, his inability to protect at least her, is manifested in his mind.
"I have to save her," Kai thinks. "But how? What can I do?" "I can't even find out who is bullying her!"

Will Kai be able to save Yuka? Or... Will she have to do it herself?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1916450/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
对凯而言，学校里的每一天都只是前一天的重复。霸凌者殴打他，嘲弄他的青梅竹马优香，姐妹也指责他没有男子气概——这一切周而复始。他生活中唯一的快乐，就是在家与优香和她的母亲凛相处。凛在村里经营着一家药店。只有在这里，他才能真正开心起来，躲开残酷的世界与接踵而来的苦难。可每当望着优香开朗的脸，他都会再次意识到自己的软弱：就连她，他都保护不了。
“我必须救她。”凯心想，“可是，要怎么做？我能做什么？”“我甚至连是谁在欺负她都查不出来！”

凯能救下优香吗？还是说…她只能靠自己？

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1916450/]Steam[/url]]
